title: Agents call timeout, which macOS lacks; recipe unnamed
what: State the recipe once in the delegate skill and the runner definition: a portable bound (nohup + log + a wait loop, no timeout program) and where the log goes.
why: The delegate skill says a runner runs relay gate detached 'with the limits recipe', but no file names or links that recipe; and the rule 'no command over 4 minutes' invites timeout.
failing_case: Trial: delegate:runner wrapped relay check show in timeout and got exit 127 on macOS.
pass_cases: The skill names the recipe with a command that runs on macOS; a runner following it never calls timeout.
